name: Payment Tracker Notification
definition: Specifies the agent specific tracking system notification of a payment transaction.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Specifies the type of notification generated by the payment tracker.

SubType.name: Sub Type
SubType.definition: Specifies the sub-type of notification generated by the payment tracker.

RelatedPaymentTracker.name: Related Payment Tracker
RelatedPaymentTracker.definition: Payment tracker which generates the notification.
